verification_semantics: No engine changes. Per-function flags are open-world: omitted flags are UNKNOWN,never a fabricated documented absence. Every matrix verdict must come from existing Lean,not these scene descriptors.
notes: Three configurations per industry are distinct real instruments relevant to at least one procedure. Cross pairings deliberately include missing capabilities and failures; membership is not suitability.
16newprofiles+5existing unique profiles cover21distinctindustry/profile slots. Additional cross-industry relevance is optional and does not inflate this count.
No new coupled-physics law was introduced. Phenomena not modeled by existing backend are reported as scope limitations,not simulated proofs.
